text: {"overall_winner":"B","qualities":[{"evidence":"clear pro-driverless position with repeated support","quality":"argumentative focus","description":"It stays more consistently centered on defending one side of the issue rather than drifting into side remarks."},{"evidence":"uses article details like half a million miles, alerts to take over, and seat vibrations","quality":"textual evidence use","description":"It brings in more specific evidence from the source article to support its claims."},{"evidence":"explains how features reduce accidents and help drivers","quality":"reasoning development","description":"It gives fuller explanation of why the evidence supports the argument instead of just asserting conclusions."},{"evidence":"opens with a hook and ends with a direct call to action","quality":"organizational completeness","description":"It has a clearer essay shape with an introduction, body development, and conclusion that reinforces the position."},{"evidence":"more sustained line of support across each paragraph","quality":"coherence","description":"Its ideas connect more smoothly from one paragraph to the next around the same main claim."},{"evidence":"attempts to address safety concerns and then answer them","quality":"counterargument handling","description":"It acknowledges the main objection to driverless cars and responds to it more directly than the other essay."}]}
